integrated_evidence: This integrated architecture enables a polarization-resolved point-cloud output by jointly providing 3D geometry, return intensity, and a polarization-derived attribute, and it attaches a point-wise material label inferred by the on-chip PolarONN.

Compared to representative electronic classification back-ends used for polarization-based material identification, our on-chip photonic inference core provides ns-scale response with a low electrical power budget for the inference module.
